standard_prerequisites.name: Splitting of a simplicial set
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof decomposes U_n and V_n by the splitting of Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-sets.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2040-2050): a map f: U -> V of simplicial sets is injective (resp. surjective, bijective) in every degree as soon as it sends nondegenerate simplices to nondegenerate simplices and is injective (resp. surjective, bijective) on nondegenerate simplices.

Verification (proof lines 2052-2071): under hypothesis (a) the map f preserves the coproduct decompositions of the splitting of Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-sets, giving a commutative diagram of coproducts over the same index set of surjections; hypothesis (b) says the induced map on the coproducts of normalized summands is injective (resp. surjective, bijective), and the splitting isomorphisms transport this to f_n.
proof_roadmap: Decompose each degree by the splitting of Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-sets.
Check f maps summands to summands using hypothesis (a).
Read off the conclusion summand-wise from hypothesis (b).
difficulty_reason: Nondegenerate testing criterion (statement 2040-2050, proof 2052-2071): the splitting decomposition diagram is written out and the conclusion is componentwise from (b); the only unwritten step (a coproduct of componentwise injective maps is injective) is the defining property of coproducts. H3.
